verdict.rationale: Elastic explicitly offers self-managed deployment options (docs-13, docs-5/17 Docker/local quickstart) and the runtime probe confirms a full, real Elasticsearch engine can be booted locally with genuine indexing/search functioning, not a stripped-down build. However community evidence flags a real caveat: historically security and other 'basic' features were paid/license-gated in self-hosted deployments (comm-3, comm-9), and some capabilities (e.g., serverless autoscaling, managed ML model hosting) are cloud-only per docs-7/21/25/26, so self-hosted parity with the fully-managed hosted product is not total. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all hosted-tier features (autoscaling, managed inference endpoints, enterprise security) are unlocked identically in self-managed without extra licensing, and independent verification beyond one probe.
